name: Still Partners
description: A small neighborhood pub and gastropub on Sea Cliff Avenue with craft beer and a full kitchen. Local bands and acoustic players perform many nights, with full bands mostly on weekends.

dancing.notes: It is a cozy room with booths and a small stage area in the back. One reviewer says you can sit in a booth or move up near the band and dance, so expect a little open space by the stage on band nights, not a real dance floor.

evidence.note: Review roundup includes a 2024 comment that you can relax in a booth or get up close to the band and dance.
Venue profile describes wood-paneled walls, booth and bar seating, and a small stage toward the back, with bands Thursday to Saturday.
The bar's Facebook page posts weekly live music lineups, such as reggae and rock bands, and calls its music a main draw.
